narr: A slow-moving cold front helped to generate showers and thunderstorms across much of the region. Some storms produced heavy rain along the Red River that resulted in nuisance flooding and flash flooding.
ev: State Highway 11 at Choctaw Creek, to the southeast of Sherman, was impassible due to high water over the roadways.
Calf Creek Lane near Bells was impassable due to high water, likely where it crosses Calf Creek.
lsr: STATE HIGHWAY 11 AT CHOCTAW CREEK REPORTED IMPASSABLE FROM WATER OVER ROADWAY.
